## Notes

Impressions Games, Sierra Studios; Windows, North America 1999-11-02; same engine and principles as Caesar III; floodplain farms by the Nile, irrigation ditches raise fertility, Osiris can improve or worsen the flood; monuments need worker facilities and materials; five gods (Ra, Bast, Osiris, Ptah, Seth); housing levels from goods, services, surroundings; Cleopatra expansion 2000; remake A New Era 2023.
